notes.title: New Game + Huge Sale! Don’t Miss It.
notes.notes:
We’ve got some awesome news, guys!

Today at 6 PM CET, we're launching our newest game: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3400650/Creepy_Shift_House_For_Sale/]Creepy Shift: House For Sale![/url]

We’ve cooked up a horror simulator spiced with absurd humor and mysterious puzzles for you to unravel.

To celebrate the release, we’re also throwing a massive[b] 90% discount on Rise of Insanity[/b] – starting today, for all horror thrill-seekers out there.

Thanks for being with us!

Red Limb Studio

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3400650/Creepy_Shift_House_For_Sale/

notes.title: Check out our next horror!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that Red Limb Studio is returning to the world of horror today. With great pride, we unveil the premiere of our latest title. It's been several long years since the release of Rise of Insanity, and we've certainly missed the genre that has always been close to our hearts.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2955590/Creepy_Shift_Roadside_Diner/]Creepy Shift: Roadside Diner[/url]

We are back for good with the CreepyShift series, and the first episode, which we warmly invite you to, is the night shift at the Roadside Diner.

Stay tuned,
Red Limb Studio

notes.title: Rise of Insanity - 50% discount
notes.notes:
Hello fellow horror maniacs! 

In this hard times we encourage you to stay home and play games. So Rise of Insanity is going to have 50% discount for a whole week!

During this sale we are supported by our friend [b]BarefootOnTheM00n[/b]. She is so kind that she is streaming Rise of Insanity gameplay for you.

notes.title: Rise of Insanity on Nintendo Switch
notes.notes:
Rise of Insanity for the Nintendo Switch will finally be released TODAY (February 13th 2020) thanks to a new partnership formed between Red Limb Studios and Pineapple Works (porting house/publisher) in late 2019.

NS version of Rise of Insanity will be sold in one part like Steam version.

Graphic even adapted to technical requirements of Nintendo Switch still is stunning and breathtaking.

[previewyoutube=_CkTNv1XpoU;full][/previewyoutube]


You can find Rise of Insanity on Nintendo under this link -> https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/rise-of-insanity-switch/

notes.title: NEW GAME IS COMMING!!!
notes.notes:
Beat Me! is a physics-based multiplayer game for up to 6 players. Play with comical fantasy characters in a wide variety of fun and surprising environments. Challenge your friends locally or beat others over the internet!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/985940/Beat_Me/


We know it's something else than Rise of Insanity, but We hope you will also like it :)

ADD BEAT ME TOP YOUR WISHLIST !


Red Limb Studio Crew

notes.title: RELEASE!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello fellow community![/h1]

Finally the time has come. Time to release the full version of Rise of Insanity. Thank you for your patience and support. Cooperation with you was a pleasure. From now the game is in full version state no Early Access as it has been so far.
 
In this release patch we added:

[list]
[*] 5 new location which you can explore.
[*] Refreshed and professional soundtrack which can be bought separately as a DLC ( available soon! ) if you liked it.
[*] Bug fixes
[*] And probably the most important thing for the all of you. End of Stephen Dowell history.
[/list]

We hope you like whole our game. Share your impressions on social media and below this post.

Best Regards
Red Limb Studio

notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.
This is our last update (before official launch).

This update contains:
- New main menu 
- New ambient music on levels
- Visual update
- Bugs fix
- Razer Chroma Support 
- Price change to 9.99$ / 9.99€

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28827887/9ac6058583352f77505fb01ba7b1c60de2194b4a.png[/img]

Now we focus on polishing our product, adding new levels and final ending.
So officially premiere will take place in the second half of February. We are very sorry for a little delay.

notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.
Thank you for staying with us and waiting to finish our game. We have many good news for you. :)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28827887/581a2fe5bb127dbacf252a189eb5ab0db22e7f2f.png[/img]

In this patch you will get: 

[h1]Content[/h1]
[list]
[*]We have introduced three new locations which are related to the continuation of Dr. Dowell's history. (Let us know if you like them) 
[*]Visual and music update.
[/list]

[h1]Graphic Options[/h1]
[list]
[*] The ability to change the quality of Antialiasing.
[*] The ability to change the quality of Ambient Occlusion.
[*] Vsync is now available.
[*] Support for new resolutions.
[/list]

[h1]Languages[/h1]
[list]
[*] Russian language support.
[*] Spanish language support.
[*] Fixed German language support.
[*] Fixed English language support.
[/list]

[h1]Big cover art update[/h1]
We also changed our cover to make our game better presented in the Steam Store.

[h1]Price change[/h1]
The current price is 6.99€ and and in January during the premiere it will change to 9.99€.


We are currently working hard to complete the game and release it in January.
Lets us know what do you think about our new content :)
